home.promise: The dress doesn’t make the woman, the woman makes the dress. A woman should not have to change herself to fit her clothes.
home.storyLead: Daysi Fernández is Honduran, and Garífuna, and she put needle to thread at twelve years old. Her father worked a spinning wheel, and its bobbin is among her clearest memories. “Sometimes I’d sneak to watch him work into the morning hours.”
home.storyBody: Her Garífuna roots run through the styles, the patterns and the textiles the collection is built from, and every piece is developed on research and careful technique. Beyond the work she is a wife, a mother, a daughter and a sister, and those commitments carry the same weight. With love and patience, the collection grows one piece at a time.
home.collectionLead: Small runs, published prices, sizes S to L.
home.pricesLead: Prices here are published once, with the cost of cloth already built in, and they are not negotiated; anything extra a piece needs is agreed with you before cutting. That is what protects the work and what makes it fair to everyone who walks in.
home.alterationsTitle: The alteration you have been putting off.
home.alterationsLead: Hems, waists, sleeves, zippers and full resizes, each with a price published in advance. Send a photo and get an answer, without a phone call.
home.premiereLead: Five or six pieces, every three months, shown before they are made.
home.storyPortraitAlt: Daysi Fernández, founder of Daysi Collection, in an emerald blouse, chin resting on her hand at the back of a wooden stool.

prices.lead: One price list feeds this whole site. Prices are set by garment and by cloth, with the cost of material already built in.
prices.howToRead: Each garment is priced by its cloth: find the garment, then the cloth. That is the price of the ready piece; made to measure adds the charge at the end of each list.
prices.variesNote: The listed price is for the piece as shown. A lining, extra work or a rush date can raise it: Daysi tells you and you agree before anything is cut, and the difference is paid separately, on collection. What you pay on this site is always the total you see.
prices.why: Why the price does not change with who asks
prices.whyBody: A price that changes per client is a price that punishes whoever asks least. Setting it once, in public, with a cushion for the cost of cloth, is what keeps the work sustainable and keeps everyone paying the same.

atelier.title: The atelier
atelier.lead: A home workroom on East 180th Street, in its eighteenth year.
atelier.bio1: This Honduran native started putting needle to thread at 12 years old. She has bold memories of her father’s spinning wheel bobbin, “Sometimes I’d sneak to watch him work into the morning hours.”
atelier.bio2: Daysi is Honduran by nationality, but she is part of the Garifuna community. Garifuna are a minority ethnicity with a robust culture in Honduras. Daysi attributes her Garifuna roots to many of the styles, patterns and textiles that inspire her collection. “When it was time to go out, I remember how elegant the women in my family dressed,” says Daysi. “Sometimes I just imagine what my mother or one of my aunts would have worn back then.”
atelier.bio3: Extensive research and careful technique govern the development and design of each piece. She is committed to making clothes for women of all shapes and sizes. “Every woman is beautiful, it just takes the right design and alterations to accentuate it,” she proudly exclaims. Daysi’s Collection works diligently to create custom pieces that embrace the client. “The dress doesn’t make the woman, the woman makes the dress. A woman should not have to change herself to fit her clothes.”
atelier.bio4: Besides being a designer, Daysi is a wife, mom, daughter and sister. Her family commitments are as important as her work. With love and patience Daysi expands her collection one piece at a time.
atelier.visitBody: The atelier is private and works by appointment, so nobody is ever fitted while somebody else waits. The full address is sent when your session is confirmed.
atelier.portraitAlt: Daysi Fernández standing in an emerald blouse, arms folded and one hand raised to her temple.

terms.title: Terms of service
terms.intro: These terms apply to every session, alteration, order and commission taken through this site. They exist so that both sides know what was agreed before any cloth is cut.

sessions.title: 1. Sessions and appointments
sessions.body: Sessions are booked as thirty minutes or one hour. The session fee is paid when you book, and it holds that time on the calendar. If a session runs past the length you booked, the extra time is billed in half-hour blocks at the rate shown on the booking page; you will always be told before the booked time runs out, and you may end the session instead. The session fee comes off any order placed within thirty days.

cancellation.title: 2. Changes and cancellations
cancellation.body: Move or cancel a session at least twenty-four hours ahead and the fee is refunded in full or carried to a new date. Inside twenty-four hours, or if nobody arrives, the fee is kept, because the time cannot be given to anyone else at that notice.

prices.title: 3. Prices
prices.body: Prices published on this site are not negotiated. They include the cost of cloth at the rates in effect when they were set. A listed price is for the piece as shown: a lining, extra work or a rush date can raise it, and any difference is told to you and agreed before work starts, and paid on collection. A written estimate is valid for thirty days. If the work you ask for changes after an estimate is given, a new estimate is issued before the work continues. The price never changes without you seeing it first.

deposits.title: 4. Deposits and payment
deposits.body: Custom pieces and made-to-measure orders take a deposit of half the total before work begins; that deposit reserves the cloth and the dates, and it is not refundable once cutting has started. The balance is due when the piece is collected. Alterations are paid on collection, once you have checked the fit. Ready-made pieces bought as cut are paid in full.

turnaround.title: 5. Timing
turnaround.body: Turnaround times shown on the alterations list are the normal case, not a guarantee. If something will be late you will hear about it before the date, not after. Rush service is available for an extra charge and moves your garment to the front of the queue.

fittings.title: 6. Fittings and fit
fittings.body: Custom pieces include two fittings. Further fittings are booked as sessions. Every alteration is guaranteed for thirty days: if the work does not sit as agreed, bring the garment back and it is corrected at no charge. This does not cover a change of mind about the design, or a change in the body it was fitted to.

garments.title: 7. Garments you leave with us
garments.body: Garments left for alteration are held at your risk and should be collected within sixty days of the work being finished. Daysi will remind you before that date. Some fabrics, finishes and prior repairs cannot be altered safely; if that is the case you will be told before anything is started, and you may take the garment back with nothing owed.

designs.title: 8. Designs and photographs
designs.body: Original designs, patterns, sketches and prints made by Daysi Collection Inc. remain hers. A commission gives you the garment, not the right to reproduce the design. Photographs of finished work may be used to show the work, unless you ask in writing that yours are not. Just say so, and they will not be.

privacy.title: 9. Your information
privacy.body: What you send through this site goes to Daysi and to nobody else. See the privacy notice for what is kept and for how long.

law.title: 10. Governing law
law.body: These terms are governed by the law of the State of New York. Nothing here removes any right you have under consumer protection law.

terms.questions: Anything here you would like explained before you book? Ask on WhatsApp. You will get a plain answer.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: A short notice, because there is not much to say: this site collects what it needs to do the work, and nothing else.
privacy.collectBody: Your name, the way you asked to be contacted, and what you wrote in the form. If you attach a photograph of a garment, that too. If you pay by card, Stripe handles the payment and this site is never sent your card number.
privacy.useBody: Answering your request and doing the work. Nothing is sold, and nothing is shared with anyone outside the business.
privacy.keepBody: Requests are kept while the work is open and for two years afterwards, so a garment can be traced back if you return. Photographs you send are deleted once the work is finished, unless you ask for them to be kept with your file.
privacy.rightsBody: Ask for a copy of what is held about you, or ask for it to be deleted, and it will be done within thirty days. Write to {email}.
privacy.cookiesBody: This site sets one cookie, to remember whether you are reading in Spanish or English. There is no advertising and no tracking of any kind.
